name: svrngs-web-tests
description: The page's browser tests: Playwright drives Chromium (u4-3) and WebKit (u4-7); and oxlint, check.sh's lint of every JavaScript file but what is vendored or recorded; and oxfmt, the formatter of those same files (.oxfmtrc.json); and TypeScript, which checks the pages' JSDoc types and emits nothing (jsconfig.json, scripts/types.mjs); and oxlint-tsgolint, which lets oxlint run the rules that read those types (scripts/typed-lint.mjs).
